name: change_slide
description: Call this to switch the on-screen deck to a specific slide. Call it BEFORE your next spoken line whenever you are about to speak about a different slide, or whenever the user asks to go next, back, previous, or jump to a specific slide. Do NOT narrate the call — do not say 'let me flip to', 'switching slides', or 'moving on'; just call the function, then speak. The deck has 7 slides, indexed 1 through 7. Refer to your briefing in conversation history for each slide's topic.

index.description: The target slide number, from 1 to 7.
